senses.gloss: m.(b. h., v. Schr. KAT2, p. 564) much; (adv.) very.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:5">Ber. IX, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>מאדך</he> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:5">Deut. VI, 5</cite>) <he>בכל מדה ומדה … הוי מודה לו במ׳ מ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Y. ed. <he>מ׳ מ׳</he>; Bab. ed. 54ᵃ <he>במ׳ מ׳</he> omitted) whatever measure he may measure out to thee, give thanks to him very, very much.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:4">Ab. IV, 4</cite> <he>מ׳ מ׳ הוי וכ׳</he> be exceedingly lowly in mind (humble).
